description: c115 iter-3 tuning: --launch-mp-room base:arena_mp_felicity base:combat 4 seeds g_MatchConfig pre-mainProc and arms post-CI main-menu auto-open (g_PostExitMainMenuView=0). With windowID populated (iter-2 worker epsilon), ACTION_USE+ACTION_MENU_DOWN can now drive Main Menu -> Solo Play -> Combat Simulator -> Room. Iter-3 finding: walking deeper (Down/Return into Room sub-screens) reliably triggers an access violation ~5s after acquiring mp_advanced + room gen=2; the crash is independent of injected keys (it fires before SDL events reach the binary). This is a NEW deeper-coverage bug surfaced by iter-2 nav. Test now backs off after confirming Combat Simulator -> Room edge to lock in regression coverage of the boot fast-path + the new room-acquired milestone WITHOUT tripping the deeper Room sub-screen crash. Deeper Room/MP-sub navigation needs a separate dispatch to investigate the post-Combat-Simulator crash class (likely related to MENUPOOL: released room gen=1 then immediately acquired mp_advanced + room gen=2 ctx=imgui_menu(owned) race).

We bail out before the crash window.

scripted exit 2s after Combat Simulator press -- locks in regression coverage of: boot -> Main Menu -> Solo Play -> Combat Simulator -> Room edge fire + MENUPOOL: acquired room. Walking deeper requires a separate dispatch to fix the post-room crash.
